forms.title: A Quick Craft
forms.raw_source:
We can get ye sorted out and out of here in no time, provided you have the materials on hand! We are going to need $1oa Mithril Bars and $2oa Heavy Leather. Normally we need some other metals and the like too, but I've got some scrap that's been taking up space we can use for those extra bits.

Oh, as a personal favor, I am gonnae ask for $3oa Goldthorn as well. My wife knows a great recipe for tea and I'd like to surprise her. Consider this your payment!
